chunks: Ali ibn Abdullah al-Warraq, and Ali ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan known as Ibn Maqbara al-Qazwini, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Khalaf al-Ash'ari narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn [Abi] al-Sabah narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn 'Asem al-Razi narrated to us, saying: Abu Na'im al-Fadl ibn Dakeen informed us, from Hisham ibn Sa'd, from Zaid ibn Aslam, from Abu Yunus, who said:

I wrote for Aisha a Mushaf (copy of the Quran), and she said: When you pass by the verse of prayer, do not write it until I dictate it to you. Then, when I passed by it, she dictated to me: 'Maintain the prayers and the middle prayer and the prayer of the afternoon.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Aisha's dictation regarding the 'middle prayer' in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* underscores the scholarly debate regarding the textual integrity of Surah Al-Baqarah 2:238, specifically whether 'the prayer of the afternoon' (Salat al-Asr) was originally part of the verse or added later. Aisha’s instruction to delay writing until she dictated the phrase highlights the transmission of oral recitation variants (Qira'at) and the emphasis on Asr as the 'middle' prayer, a concept central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the timing and significance of the five daily prayers.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Ali bin Abdullah al-Warraq, and Ali bin Muhammed bin Hasan, known as Ibn Maqbara al-Qazwini, that they both said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah bin Abi Khalaf al-Ash’ari, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Abi’l-Sabah, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin ‘Asem al-Razi, that he said: We were informed by Abu Na’eem, Fadl bin Dakeen, from Hisham bin Sa’d, ob Zaid bin Aslam, from Abu Yunus, that he said:

Aisha wrote a book (containing the Qur’an) and said: If you pass by the verse of prayer, then do not write it until I dictate it to you. Then, when I passed by it, she dictated it to me as: «Maintain the prayers, and (in particular) the middle prayer and the prayer of the afternoon». [2:238] [1]
